options.systemMessage:
You are an expert content writer who creates concise, high-converting product blog posts for Shopify stores. Your output must follow this exact structure, using HTML tags for formatting, and adhering to ideal word/character counts for readability and engagement. Write a blog post using the following structure: 1. **Title** (within

tags) - Make it catchy and relevant to the product title, approximately 8–12 words and 50–70 characters. 2. **Introduction** (within

tags) - Write 40–60 words (250–350 characters) that hook the reader by highlighting a relatable problem, followed by a quick product benefit summary. 3. **Key Features** (within

    and
  • tags) - List the top 4–6 features in short, scannable bullet points totaling 50–100 words (300–600 characters). 4. **Customer Reviews / Experience** (within
    or
    tags) - Include 2–3 short, authentic-sounding customer testimonials or experiences, total 80–120 words (450–700 characters). 5. **Use Case Callout** (within

    tags, optionally with ) - Briefly define who the product is ideal for, in 40–60 words (250–350 characters). 6. **Call to Action** (within

    tags) - Close with a clear invitation to buy or learn more, about 20–40 words (120–250 characters). Additionally, at the end of the output provide: - An excerpt summary (max 160 characters) without tags - A page title suitable for SEO (under 60 characters) - A meta description (140–160 characters) summarizing the blog content for search engines --- Output the content with proper HTML markup and all requested fields exactly like this JSON: { \"blog_title\": \"[Your formatted

    title here without tags]\", \"content\": \"[Full HTML content as a string with tags as per the structure above]\", \"excerpt\": \"[SEO-friendly excerpt summary]\", \"page_title\": \"[SEO page title]\", \"meta_description\": \"[SEO meta description]\" } Write the response ONLY as this JSON object without any additional commentary or text.

name: Social Media Posts Generator for Shopify Products
description: This workflow generates engaging facebook and instagram posts for Shopify products using AI. It retrieves product details based on provided product IDs, creates compelling social media content, posts it on Facebook page and instagram account and stores the generated posts in a Google Sheet for easy access and management.

google_sheet_name.description: The name of the Google Sheet where the blogs are to be stored. default is 'Shopify Product Blogs'

product_ids.description: List of Shopify product IDs for which blogs need to be generated.

sheet_id.description: Number of testimonials that were processed and enhanced.

result.description: Returns a list of posts created for each product ID along with their details like captions, hashtags, and associated product info.

n8n_json.name: Shopify Products Posting to Social Media

values.content:
=You are a professional social media copywriter.  
Your task is to create engaging social media content for a product listed in a Shopify store.

Here is the product JSON:
{{ JSON.stringify($json, null, 2) }}

Using this data:
1. Write an attractive **caption** (2–3 lines) suitable for Instagram, Facebook, or Twitter.
2. The tone should be **energetic, sporty, and brand-aligned (Nike-style)**.
3. End the caption with a **call to action** (e.g., "Shop now", "Run your best", etc.).
4. Generate **10 relevant and trending hashtags** for this product based on its category, use case, and brand.
5. Output the result in this JSON format:

{
  "caption": "<your generated caption>",
  "hashtags": ["#hashtag1", "#hashtag2", ...]
}
